answer_4.quote: We asked two people to produce the gold annotations. An annotation instance is a body part mention in a sentence and the three preceding sentences as context. The annotators produced a binary label (Embodied Emotion vs. Neutral) to indicate if the body part is associated with an embodied emotion, following the definition in Section 3.1.
